target_anchor.descriptor: Can choose an appropriate chart type for a stated audience and message, avoiding common distortions like a truncated axis or misleading scale.

competencies.description: Spatial data, geographies, joins, and thematic mapping.

target_anchor.descriptor: Can diagnose and fix a geographic join error, such as mismatched boundary vintages or a coordinate system mismatch, in a spatial dataset.

competencies.description: Modern data pipelines, scale, governance, and cloud concepts.

target_anchor.descriptor: Can evaluate a big-data or cloud-based source for statistical fitness-for-use -- coverage, bias, timeliness -- before it is adopted.
